hook_line: INDIA ON TRACK TO HIT $1 TRILLION IN EXPORTS THIS YEAR

hook_stat.sub: Goods and services exports India is on track to reach this year

news_summary: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said India is on track to hit $1 trillion in exports of goods and services this year, after October exports hit a record $89.99 billion.
payoff: The $1 trillion figure is a target for the financial year ending March 31, 2027, not yet a reported outcome.
